digest.component_or_area: CI capability mapping / environment contract authoring
propositions: On-demand CI job must boot digest-pinned Jira DC image and interrogate it to produce committed environment contract data, not discover contract at test time

Job answers a bounded checklist of questions about issue types, workflows, statuses, priorities, link types, field IDs, and field length limits, with raw REST request/response evidence for each answer

Link-type mapping must capture direction (inward/outward name pairs) and validate via end-to-end read-back experiment, not name-only presence check, because direction inversions silently produce wrong-way links
Job must report findings without mutating the instance, cannot execute on push/PR/schedule (workflow_dispatch-only with assertion test), and cannot be reached from fork PRs
Reported image digest must be derived from Dockerfile FROM line, not hardcoded as separate literal, and committed as asserted data so map staleness after re-pin is detectable
Accept-and-truncate behavior for length limits must be detected by read-back comparison, not inferred from successful write, because Jira may silently truncate without error
